in_urdu.name: بہین
in_urdu.meaning: ظاہر اور آشکار کرنے والا، اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک

historical_references.reference: The name Baheen is believed to have originated from the village of Baheen in present-day Iraq, which was a significant center of Islamic scholarship during the Abbasid Caliphate (750-1258 CE). Many prominent scholars, including Al-Jahiz, were born and raised in this village, which contributed significantly to the development of Islamic thought and literature.

Another reference suggests that the name Baheen may have been given to a famous scholar named Al-Baqir Al-Baheeni, who lived during the early Abbasid period (8th century CE). He was a renowned scholar of Hadith and Fiqh and was known for his extensive knowledge and teaching abilities.
